info.title: TechBridge scholarship priority and human allocation
info.description: Extends the existing application/award service. No score, waitlist or appeal automatically awards. Private financial evidence is scoped to the applicant and owning verified provider. See scholarship-priority.md for legacy compatibility, fairness limits, retention and coordinated rollout. Existing common success messages remain; no live credential or deployment target is included.

get.description: Authenticated student: open, unexpired scholarship only. Provider: own scholarship. Exposes exact rules, current policy revision, frozen/strict flags and student eligibility preview; no private applicant data.

200.description: Read published/default programme policy

put.summary: Configure policy before the first application
put.description: Owning currently verified provider only. Full normalized settings, expected revision and human reason. Initial revision 0; explicit configuration activates strict decisions. Frozen after first application. Policy history includes the full settings snapshot.

200.description: Configure policy before the first application

get.description: Current verified programme owner only. Policy events sorted createdAt/ID descending. No private application evidence or appeals are included.

200.description: Read own programme configuration history

get.description: Owning verified provider only. Actual status=waitlisted records, score/date/ID order, bounded page metadata. Read counts are not reservations; missing snapshots are labeled, never auto-awarded.

200.description: Read the persisted ranked waitlist

post.summary: Record an explicit human waitlist award
post.description: Requires a selected currently waitlisted application, current decision revision and reason. Non-first queue choices need a priority override reason. Uses the original student/opportunity locks and checks actual capacity, evidence, current eligibility and mutually compatible benefit policies. Never auto-selects or auto-fills a place.

200.description: Record an explicit human waitlist award

get.summary: Read own scholarship assessment and decision metadata
get.description: Only the applicant or verified provider owning both application and listing. No admin override. Policy/score snapshots, current eligibility, evidence count/requirement, moderation and appeal flags; null assessment for legacy records not yet materialized. Reading does not mutate decisions.

200.description: Read own scholarship assessment and decision metadata

get.description: Applicant or owning verified provider only; links precise document/appeal IDs without exposing bytes or copied appeal statements. Stable reverse-date/ID pagination.

200.description: Read scoped scholarship history

get.description: Applicant or owning verified provider; at most three metadata records. Data and fingerprints are excluded.

200.description: List private evidence metadata

post.description: Own scholarship only. Up to three unique fingerprinted PDF/PNG/JPEG files of 2 MiB each. Existing conservative validator is reused; bytes, metadata and audit linkage commit atomically. No external links/fetching or public file route.

get.description: Applicant-owner only. No-store octet-stream attachment with nosniff and a generic safe filename. A provider cannot use this GET route to bypass access auditing.

200.description: Download the applicant's own attachment

post.summary: Audit and download one exact evidence document
post.description: Current verified owner of both application and source listing only. Human access reason required. Exact document-ID audit commits before bytes are returned; audit failure denies download. No automatic admin access.

200.description: Audit and download one exact evidence document

get.description: Applicant or owning verified provider only, reverse-date/ID order; at most three service-created appeals. Statements are confidential.

200.description: List private appeals and outcomes

post.summary: Appeal a rejected or waitlisted decision
post.description: Applicant-owner only, matching current decision revision. One appeal per revision, three/application maximum. Does not change decision or award state. Pending appeal blocks other changed provider status decisions.

201.description: Appeal a rejected or waitlisted decision

post.summary: Uphold a decision or reopen human review
post.description: Owning verified provider; current pending appeal/revision only. Reopened moves the application to reviewed, increments its revision and clears queue membership. Neither outcome awards automatically. Concurrent/repeated reviews conflict.

200.description: Uphold a decision or reopen human review

post.summary: Recalculate and audit an advisory score
post.description: Owning verified provider; reason required. Reuses the frozen settings/original cohort timing window and current profile/accepted benefits. Logs the new score; status and capacity do not change.

200.description: Recalculate and audit an advisory score

post.summary: Submit an application with the existing 201 envelope
post.description: Existing opportunity eligibility/justification/need validation remains. Scholarship submissions serialize with policy freeze and create advisory snapshots. Configured programmes assign strict mode server-side; student-supplied actor/version/award metadata is ignored. Default unconfigured clients retain legacy decision compatibility. Duplicate application remains 409.

201.description: Submit an application with the existing 201 envelope

patch.description: Both recorded owners must match. Scholarship capacity/duplicate locks are preserved. Strict changed decisions require reason and valid transition; default legacy calls can omit reasons with explicit provenance. Optional revision detects stale changes; exact repeats are idempotent. Overrides do not bypass allocation or moderation restrictions. Non-scholarship waitlisting is rejected.

200.description: Record a human application decision

get.summary: Read own applications with additive scholarship metadata
get.description: Existing envelope and own-only filter preserved; source listing may be null for old orphan records. No evidence bytes or appeal statements are embedded.

200.description: Read own applications with additive scholarship metadata

get.description: Requires both recorded application owner and current listing owner; mismatched/orphaned listings are excluded. Persisted scholarship snapshots override legacy live scoring. Fixes string/ObjectId benefit aggregation and stable score/date/ID ties. No evidence bytes are embedded.

200.description: Read owned applicant priority results

get.summary: Read applicants for an owned opportunity
get.description: Both application and listing provider IDs must match. Priority order uses earliest application then ID on equal scores. Strict snapshots reflect actual waitlisted status; old live capacity flags do not create queue membership.

200.description: Read applicants for an owned opportunity

put.summary: Edit an opportunity with scholarship guards
put.description: Existing validation/capability/ownership remains. Capacity cannot fall below accepted allocations; scholarship type cannot change after applications. Strict-programme published terms and earlier deadlines are frozen. Moderation-withdrawn scholarships cannot be republished.

200.description: Edit an opportunity with scholarship guards

delete.summary: Delete only when scholarship source history will not be orphaned
delete.description: Scholarships with applications return 409; close instead. No-application and non-scholarship deletion retain the existing success envelope. Serializes with new scholarship applications. No normal app/production deletion is performed by tests.

200.description: Delete only when scholarship source history will not be orphaned

delete.summary: Withdraw public content while retaining scholarship history
delete.description: Existing moderation action: scholarships with applications are closed and permanently flagged, not physically deleted. Provider cannot reopen or grant new awards from them. Unapplied/non-scholarship listings retain removal behavior. Existing AuditLog action identifies retained closure; no private scholarship evidence access is granted.

200.description: Withdraw public content while retaining scholarship history

patch.summary: Resolve a report with safe scholarship removal
patch.description: Existing report workflow; removeTarget on a scholarship with applications withdraws public content but preserves linked records. New scoped audit action records retained closure. Private-message handling and resource workflow remain unchanged.

200.description: Resolve a report with safe scholarship removal

bearerAuth.description: Full expiring HS256 session; persisted roles, suspension, provider verification and token-version revocation remain authoritative.

Weights.description: Whole percentages totaling exactly 100. Defaults 40/30/20/10. Components may be zero; these are not universally fair weights.

degrees.description: Case-insensitive ICT/ET/BST/other; empty permits any programme.

institutions.description: Exact case-insensitive normalized labels, not independent affiliation verification.

requireEvidence.description: Evidence is required before award; an application can be submitted before attaching it.

Eligibility.description: minStudyYear <= maxStudyYear. Lists are normalized/deduplicated plain text. Free-text listing criteria remain human instructions.

duplicateBenefitPolicy.description: Legacy server-local application-date calendar year, all currently accepted scholarship allocations, or mutual allow-multiple. Prior stricter commitments still apply.

reason.description: Trimmed plain text; markup/control characters are rejected.

PolicyInput.description: Provider-owner only, full settings replacement before the first application. Initial revision is 0. Unknown ownership/authority fields do not change the authenticated owner.

Priority.description: Advisory snapshot only. Self-declared need is not verified income. Human decisions and allocation checks remain mandatory.

scholarshipVersion.description: Server owned; activated by explicit provider policy. Applicant version fields are ignored.

isWaitlisted.description: On persisted reviews this reflects status=waitlisted. Legacy live results may still expose the old derived capacity flag.

Application.description: Existing participant-owned application envelope, with additive read-only scholarship metadata. Populated student/listing fields retain the existing contract.

Assessment.description: Null for a legacy record not yet materialized by an authorized mutation. Reads do not create decisions.

reason.description: Trimmed plain text; markup/control characters are rejected.

priorityOverrideReason.description: Trimmed plain text; markup/control characters are rejected.

DecisionInput.description: Strict programme changed decisions require reason; older unconfigured clients retain status-only calls with explicit missing-reason provenance. Supplied stale revisions conflict; identical decisions are idempotent. Scores never grant an award.

SubmissionInput.description: Existing POST contract. The server chooses strict mode from provider policy; student/provider IDs, workflow markers and timestamps cannot be mass-assigned. A configured rule mismatch rejects before records are created.

fileName.description: Safe filename without paths or '..'; PDF/PNG/JPG/JPEG extension must match validated content.

content.description: Canonical base64, at most 2 MiB decoded. Conservative existing format validator; no active/encrypted PDF features, SVG, archive, external URL fetching or antivirus guarantee.

AppealInput.description: Only own rejected/waitlisted decision. One appeal per revision, at most three/application. Pending appeals block changed decisions.

reason.description: Trimmed plain text; markup/control characters are rejected.

AppealReview.description: Provider-owner review. Reopened returns application to reviewed without awarding; upheld preserves decision/revision. Stale/repeated reviews conflict.

Event.description: Scoped immutable domain history; no evidence bytes, fingerprints or copied appeal statements.

reason.description: Trimmed plain text; markup/control characters are rejected.
Trimmed plain text; markup/control characters are rejected.

priorityOverrideReason.description: Trimmed plain text; markup/control characters are rejected.

AdvanceInput.description: Explicit human award request for a still-waitlisted application. Non-first ranked choice through this endpoint needs priorityOverrideReason. No capacity/eligibility/benefit override.

Opportunity.description: Existing listing response. scholarshipWithdrawnByAdmin is server owned; closed retained records cannot be republished or award more places.

OpportunityEdit.description: Existing validated partial opportunity update. After strict applications, published title/description/skills/location/work mode/amount/currency/coverage/criteria/renewability are frozen. Capacity cannot fall below accepted count. Deadline extension keeps original scoring anchors; shortening is rejected. Withdrawn listings cannot be edited.

ModerationInput.description: Existing report contract. Removing a scholarship with applications closes/flags it and preserves source records; no private evidence permission is added.

assessment.description: Authorized own-application review snapshot, with updated advisory priority/calculation time; does not change status.

OptionalModerationReason.description: Existing optional moderation reason; this does not grant private scholarship review access.

Invalid.description: Invalid ID, body, unsupported rule, revision, file format or missing human reason.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, revoked, expired or restricted bearer session.

Forbidden.description: Wrong persisted role, suspended actor, unverified provider or permanently withdrawn listing action.

Missing.description: Unknown/inaccessible application, scholarship, appeal or evidence; ownership of both records is checked.

Conflict.description: Frozen policy/terms, stale decision/appeal, duplicate submission, queue mismatch, eligibility/evidence/capacity/benefit restriction or per-application limit.

TooLarge.description: Decoded evidence exceeds 2 MiB or shared request body limit is exceeded.

UnsupportedEncoding.description: Shared parser does not support the request encoding.

Unavailable.description: Generic service failure; no raw database, submitted content or stack trace. On an uncertain write response, reload own data before retrying.
